Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Job Role & Responsibilities: 
 1. Plan, implement, integrate, migrate, and perform acceptance tests for IP/optical/RF/IT networks. 
 2. Analyze network performance, resolve complex network problems, and optimize network architecture.
 3. Act as technical point of contact in front of the engineering team, customer, or vendor.
 4. Engage directly with the marketing team, project team, and customer for the purpose of promoting and delivering strategic services.
 5. Lead or be part of a global technical delivery team. Supervise a team in technical-related matters.
 Job Requirements: 
 1. Fresh graduate, holding a Bachelor’s Degree qualification or above in Telecommunication / IT / Computer Science / Engineering / or other related technical discipline.
 2. Professional working proficiency in English.
 3. Availability for traveling and international assignments (~50% of the time)
 What we offer 
A professional career in one of the leading multinational telecommunication companies
Challenging work and competitive salary package.
Travel allowance maximum 100 $/day for hard ship countries.
Long-term traveling will add an additional allowance maximum 15,000$/ year. 
Monthly meal tickets for each working day when you work in Bucharest. 
For a portion of sports, we provide discounts to World Class, Sweat and ESX.
We care about how you feel, so you’ll have access to extensive private medical insurance at Regina Maria.
Referral bonus. 
In love with books? Bookster subscription for avid readers.
Need to shorten your day due to a personal reason? You can access 4h paid leave per month.
We see your value; based on your performance, you will have an annual bonus, 1-2 salaries for qualified employees, and it can reach up to 4 for exceptional ones.
Just for fun :) Discounts to different activities (Therme, Hard Rock Cafe, Fayn, Costadoro Promenada Mall, Trickshot, Lensa, City Dent, VMAX, Balance Clinic)
We care about the well-being of our employees; therefore, you have free access to the company's own Gym, which recently opened in the office
Fruitful Wednesday - weekly, fresh fruits in the office.
500 RON discount for Lenses and Glasses
SIM / Transportation and other allowance.
